sql_reading_A.note: هنا variance فُسرت على أنها sample variance.
sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH dept_enrollment AS (
    SELECT
        s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
        s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
      ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'
      AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1
),
dept_stats AS (
    SELECT
        department_name,
        AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS average_enrolled,
        MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled,
        VAR_SAMP(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_enrolled
    FROM dept_enrollment
    GROUP BY department_name
),
math_units AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_units,
        VAR_SAMP(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
    JOIN OPA_PERSON_CURRENT p
      ON p.MIT_ID = s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
    WHERE s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND p.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
          WHERE c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
            AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
      )
)
SELECT
    d.department_name,
    d.average_enrolled,
    d.range_enrolled,
    d.variance_enrolled,
    CASE
        WHEN d.department_name = 'Mathematics'
        THEN m.average_units
    END AS average_units,
    CASE
        WHEN d.department_name = 'Mathematics'
        THEN m.units_variance
    END AS units_variance
FROM dept_stats d
CROSS JOIN math_units m
ORDER BY d.department_name;
